newsitem.title: USA: CME Feb, April live cattle set contract highs.
newsitem.headline: CME Feb, April live cattle set contract highs.

text.p: CME February and April live cattle futures set contract highs at mid-morning Thursday in fast trading in reaction to higher cash cattle prices paid at High Plains feedlots, CME traders said.
CME February live cattle set a contract high of 67.500 cents per lb and April set a contract high of 68.800.
Plains feedlots reported $1.00 higher trades of $66.00 per cwt Thursday and analysts said cash prices should continue higher, probably peaking at or near $70.00 per cwt in April.
Active commercial buying fueled much of the gain in CME February and April live cattle, which some traders said appeared to be short covering.
At 1038 CST, live cattle were up 0.850 to 0.400 cent with February up 0.675 at 67.425 cents and April was up 0.850 at 68.625 cents.
